name: Can I rent out an attached ADU for additional income?

mainEntity.name: Can I rent out an attached ADU for additional income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in most areas, including those we serve, you can rent out an attached ADU. Many homeowners build ADUs specifically to generate rental income, which can help offset mortgage payments or provide a new revenue stream. It's important to understand local rental regulations, which can include rules about short-term versus long-term rentals. We can discuss general considerations, but recommend consulting with a real estate professional for specific rental market advice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, attached ADUs can typically be rented out for income, but local rental regulations should be understood.
